description_en: Obtain queue information under the skill group dimension in online monitoring. Supports queries grouped by instance, time range, department, and skill group
description_zh: 获取在线监控下技能组纬度队列信息。支持实例、时间区间、部门、技能组分组查询
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs get-queue-information --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --start-date 1615083365000 --end-date 1617761765000 --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --dep-ids 123 --group-ids 111 --exist-department-grouping false --exist-skill-group-grouping false --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetQueueInformation

parameters.help_en:
The Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.

You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh:
AICCS实例ID。
您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The start UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小。取值大于0，默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The current page. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页。取值大于0，默认值：1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The list of skill group IDs
parameters.name: group_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query by department grouping. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否根据部门分组查询。默认值：false。取值：

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: exist_department_grouping

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query data grouped by skill group. Default value: false. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否根据技能组分组查询。默认值：false。取值：

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: exist_skill_group_grouping
